191. The People Leading the Era (2)

-"Recording and storage... If we can turn this into a union technology, all the knights of the union might be able to fight like magic swordsmen. Even if they have no magical power at the first star level, they just need to use the stored magic at the right moment."
These were the words Valeria had said in the transmission from Mariette.
From the moment Jin and Valeria confirmed the existence of the 'storage paper', they had already decided on its use.
"A Magic Knight Squadron…?”
When the colleagues asked with curious looks, Jin took out the storage paper from his pocket and explained.

"Wow, so can we say that the storage paper is a device that has improved the activation type magic circle into a portable version through recording magic? It's an area that has been researched in the academic society for hundreds of years, and to think that it was already completed a long time ago. Could it be that magic users like me are gradually becoming obsolete…?”
"The current limit of storage paper is practically eight-star magic. Even that, the highest-grade storage paper is too expensive, so it's not efficient."
{[Correct. However, if we ignore the investment cost and production time, it is possible to store 10-star magic.]}
Even when the union's financial situation was at its best, creating a storage paper for 10-star magic was a considerable burden. Especially in these tight financial times, it was needless to say.

"With the recent situation in the union, at best, we could only produce one or two pieces of 10-star paper. Even if it's a bit of a stretch, it would be good to have that much prepared for special situations."

The important thing was that there was no problem in creating storage papers for 7-star magic and below. While it may not seem as highlighted due to the presence of powerful beings in the world, in a general standard, 7-star certainly belonged to the realm of masters.

Wars are not only fought by transcendental beings. The quality and size of troops matter just as much as the number of superhumans. The storage paper will dramatically increase the quality of the troops. With more and more volunteers flocking to Runcandel, the size was also continuously increasing.
'If only I have a bit more time, I might be able to catch up with the troop sizes of Ziepfel and Kinzelo. Until we're fully prepared, I need to keep them in check.'
New demons were continuously being added to Kinzelo, and Ziepfel was making biological golems of magic swordsmen.
To close the gap and surpass them, all the preparations currently underway must be successfully completed.
"Anyway, if the commercialization of storage paper is realized, it will certainly be a significant advantage for knights rather than pure mages."

"Enya, why do you think only knights will use the storage paper? If mages also use storage paper, they become simultaneous chant users at a minimum. Then they'll be able to see the effects of super simultaneous chants."
Valeria said.
The combat power of a mage capable of simultaneous chanting is usually superior to a knight of the same grade. Therefore, it was a great benefit not only for the knights but also for the mages.
"Ah, right?"
{[The storage papers given are a total of three thousand sheets. If you create a production workshop, you should be able to add more quickly.]}
Of course, the task of creating storage paper requires the magic of recording.
In other words, it meant one more task was added to Valeria, who was already busy, and Riet, who was even busier.
"I'll set up the paper storage production workshop in the Sword Garden. Jet, repair the Red Owl. We need to inform the harvesters in Runcandel right away."
"Yes, my lord!"
{[Hey, guys!]}
"What can we do for you, Lord Zhen?"
{[I'd like to talk to my descendant, like Teben does. He's a low-level engineer, right? Although I might be old, I still have a lot of technology to pass on.]}
Saieul, who was called, broke into tears at the sound of his ancestor's voice, feeling a strange sense of relief.
{[Teben's descendant seemed very clever, but my descendant is this crybaby. Stop crying, I'll transform you into a top-class engineer.]}
"Sniff, yes, ancestor!"
"Thank you, Saieul Rootbeer. The technology we gained thanks to you is invaluable. You can ask for anything you want as a reward."

"I'd be content just working as a researcher in the Vamel Alliance... But if you insist, about a thousand gold coins per month for research expenses, an invitation to Vermont Academy seminars, and covering the expenses of a first-class accommodation each time would be nice."
Although quite explicit and specific, his request was fairly modest. Plus, Saieul's demand was solely for the sake of his research.
"I'll ensure you live a life free from worries about research funding or any other support. Feel free to ask for anything else you need in the future."
The historical first communication ended with Zhen and Saieul's conversation. There was no need to be disappointed since they would be communicating frequently from now on.

"Now, we have two communication devices left. One will stay here in Tikan, and the other will go to Runcandel. The next devices will be set up in the Empire, then in Hidden Palace and the Kingdom, and finally on Blacksmith's Island."

These were all central locations of the Vamel Alliance. If all these areas could communicate organically 24/7, there would be no future issues with information being lost or delayed. Also, the manpower needed for information delivery could be reduced.
"Dr. Qwaul, how long will it take to complete the additional communication devices?"
"If the supply of the blue diamond stone, the core ingredient written in the manual, goes smoothly, one month per piece should be enough."
Although blue diamond stone was an extremely rare mineral, both Runcandel and Tikan had small quantities in their possession.
"Dr. Qwaul, please try to hand over all construction site tasks to Luche as quickly as possible. So you can focus on the communication devices and golem production."

"I understand. It's necessary. But it will take some time. As you know, Luche is quite stubborn. We can't help but go through some process to make the eager kids become cautious. But don't worry, I'll finish the next communication device within a month."
"Also, if possible, look for a way to make the communication devices portable, not just stationary."
"That's a given. Now, go on. Whether it's a construction site or technology development, report back whenever there's a result."
Huphester Alliance, city of Calon.
Lueth smiled broadly after hearing the information and harvests that Jin brought. The Knights, stewards, and scribes by her side also applauded the good news, though their faces were all pale.
"By the way, all of you seem to need some rest, Steward."
"Do we? However, Lady Lueth, flowers that bloom overcoming adversity are more beautiful. Other families might rest at this time, but this is Runcandel
"I see."
"Of course, if it's an order, we should follow."
"I trust the Steward will manage it well."
Jin felt a sense of relief that Lueth was not his superior, while the others silently ground their teeth, some with tears in their eyes.

"Thank you. How could we, the lower beings, dare to rest when you have painstakingly obtained such forward-thinking items for us? Hehe, despite everyone being tired, their efficiency at work is actually improving."
Jin had not suffered at all on Hanka Island. In fact, he felt a bit guilty for spending such a good time with Valeria.

"A communication device... It can be used in so many places. After it's been distributed to all the hubs of the Alliance, it would be great if you, Lord, and the Knights could each carry one, assuming Dr. Qwaul can make such improvements."
Lueth's gaze landed on the storage paper.
Seeing it reminded her of the good old days of Runcandel, once a family of magicians, and she had a bitter smile on her face.

"Producing storage paper is not that difficult. It doesn't require a lot of resources up to 7-star, so if Valeria and I cut down on our sleep time, we should somehow manage the supply. Although we probably won't be able to mass-produce them for every high-ranking knight."
Lueth squinted as if contemplating something, then continued.

"But it wouldn't be efficient if Valeria and I were to just focus on producing storage paper. I think if we fine-tune the recording magic needed for production, my younger siblings and the kids from the Wontaramo Forest could help."
At Lueth's suggestion, Jin and Valeria's eyes widened.
The fairy descendants' Ga-wangju ability, which they used to craft, was in essence a derivative of recording magic. Although inferior to recording magic, the nature of the ability was very similar.
"That would be perfect if we could mass-produce them."

"First, I will distribute the 3,000 sheets of storage paper we brought from the transmission site only to the top-ranking knights. And the ones we produce afterward should be given to current knights and students who are particularly outstanding."
"Do you have any specific people in mind?"
"Yes, I will make sure that you can personally check them out soon, Lord."
"But Steward, is there a particular reason to distribute the storage paper only to the top-ranking knights? It would be quite useful for other Knights, excluding me."
"Oh, I got so carried away with the good news that I forgot to report. 7th Generation, 11th Generation. Please show Lord the recent achievements you've made."
Mary and Heytona.
They looked more exhausted than the other people in the steward's office. Jin watched his brothers with a sympathetic heart.
The two held out their right hands towards Jin.
And above their palms, each had a flame and frost flickering respectively.
'...Magic!?'
Jin knew that as Zipfel's historical manipulation weakened, the brothers' magical power was awakening.
But he had never imagined that it had progressed this far.
When Jin showed surprise, Lueth smiled and said.
"I've been helping the Knights regain their magical power and teaching them magic. As you can see, they're making quite rapid progress."
